Bash: cd "C:\Users\10273\home\work\Z-Scope_1.31\Z-Scope\.coordination\20261014\workspaces\s08-owner" && MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "cd /mnt/c/Users/10273/home/work/Z-Scope_1.31/Z-Scope/.coordination/20261014/workspaces/s08-owner && /home/zeal/venv313/bin/python -m black --diff zscope/orchestration/jobs/store.py zscope/orchestration/jobs/owner.py zscope/orchestration/jobs/service.py zscope/orchestration/jobs/models.py zscope/orchestration/jobs/identity.py tests/test_scan_jobs.py tests/test_scan_job_execution.py > .s08-artifacts/_black_current.diff 2>&1; cd .s08-artifacts/_black_baseline && /home/zeal/venv313/bin/python -m black --diff . > ../_black_orig.diff 2>&1; true" && python - <<'EOF'
import re
from pathlib import Path
base = Path(r"C:\Users\10273\home\work\Z-Scope_1.31\Z-Scope\.coordination\20261014\workspaces\s08-owner\.s08-artifacts")

def hunks(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    result = {}
    current = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"^--- (\S+)", line)
        if m:
            name = m.group(1).split("/")[-1]
            if name == ".":  # baseline dir run uses './<file>'
                continue
            current = name
            result.setdefault(current, [])
            continue
        if line.startswith("@@") and current:
            result[current].append(line)
    return result

cur = hunks(base / "_black_current.diff")
orig = hunks(base / "_black_orig.diff")
for name in sorted(set(cur) | set(orig)):
    c, o = cur.get(name, []), orig.get(name, [])
    # compare hunk CONTEXT (first line numbers shift with insertions; compare counts and content signatures)
    cs = [h.split("@@")[1].strip() for h in c]
    os_ = [h.split("@@")[1].strip() for h in o]
    print(f"{name}: current_hunks={len(c)} orig_hunks={len(o)}")
    extra = [h for h in cs if h not in os_]
    if extra:
        print("  NEW hunk regions:", extra)
EOF
